Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the disclosure of estimated debt service costs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disclosure of estimated state debt servicecosts; amending RCW 43.88.031; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.88.031 and 1991 c 284 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A capital appropriation bill ((shall)) must include theestimated general fund debt service costs associated with new capitalappropriations contained in that bill for the biennia in which theappropriations occur and for the succeeding two biennia. The estimatedgeneral fund debt service costs must be itemized by functional areas ofgovernment, including, but not limited to, general government agencies,human services agencies, corrections, natural resources, publicschools, community and technical colleges, fouryear higher educationinstitutions, housing, community development, and local projects. Theitemization must also be included in the bill's supporting documentsprepared by the legislative fiscal committees. (2) Using the categories of expenditures identified in subsection(1) of this section, an operating appropriation bill makingappropriations for state debt service must include an estimated p. 1 SB 5132itemization of the debt services expenditures contained in that bill.The estimated itemization must be calculated by the state treasurer andmust also be included in the bill's supporting documents prepared bythe legislative fiscal committees.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
